text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Hamed Karoui reports to President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali on his talks with Moroccan officials during his visit to Rabat last week.
- President Ben Ali signs decrees raising the minimum wage.
- International Airports Council director Paul Gaines visiting Tunisia for talks with Tunisian officials.
- President Ben Ali names new ambassadors to Canada, Mauritania, Lebanon, Russia and Ukraine.
